**Is the VA El Paso Healthcare System part of that group?**

The 47 reports listed in the cluster’s member list do **not** include the VA El Paso Healthcare System. None of the 47 member items name “El Paso” or the station number “648” (the El Paso VA’s station number)【2†L5-L94】.
